body:
![Golden Craft Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e599b0acc034c24dfc448e766d397899ee7b2e82.png)

this modpack is made to make minecraft more fun as a game with the foundation of a custom combo of optimization mods and mods i believe make minecraft more exciting and fun

It adds better world gen (everything the Essential Mod adds), new structures, and more will be added in the future. I hope you enjoy the modpack!

### List of Features:
* Zoom
* Better World Gen
* Shaders
* Optimization
* Dungeons and Taverns
* Fullbright
* Multiplayer
* custom UI
* and more...
